title: V-8 ENGINE "454" C.I.D. HI PERF.- REAR STABILIZER SHAFT
summary: LS5 454 rear stabilizer shaft (rear sway bar) and end links. The bar [2] is held to the frame by bushings [8] in brackets [9] with screws [10] threaded into weld nuts on the frame. Each bar end connects through a bushed link [4] (bushings [1], bolts [3], nuts [12]) to a bracket [7] that is bolted to the rear spindle support arm (trailing arm) [13] with bolts [5], washers [6] and a backing plate [11] underneath. LH shown, RH opposite.

parts.name: BOLT
parts.name_expanded: Bolt – link bracket to spindle support arm

parts.name: BRACKET
parts.name_expanded: Bracket – stabilizer link, on spindle support arm

parts.name: PLATE
parts.name_expanded: Plate – backing plate under spindle support arm

parts.name: SPINDLE SUPT ARM & BRAKE ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Spindle support arm (rear trailing arm) & brake assembly (LH/RH)

fastening.note: Bushing [8] on the shaft [2] is clamped by bracket [9]; screw [10] goes up from below through the bracket into a weld nut on the frame (no separate nut).
Bolt [3] passes through the shaft [2] end eye, bushing [1] and the top of link [4]; nut [12] on the other side.
Lower end of link [4] with bushing [1]: bolt [3] through the link and bracket [7], nut [12]. Note: press bushing until flange bottoms out on outboard side of link.
Two bolts [5] with washers [6] go down through bracket [7] and the top of the spindle support arm into plate [11] underneath. Note: install [11] with end protruding from arm as shown.

notes: NOTE: L.H. shown. R.H. symmetrically opposite.
NOTE: Press bushing until flange bottoms out on outboard side of link.
NOTE: Install [11] with end protruding from arm as shown.
notes_internal: Plate [11] appears to carry the threads for bolts [5] (no separate nuts shown); not stated explicitly.
Item 13 carries a half-filled circle symbol with no legend on this sheet.
Spindle support arm [13] itself is installed per the base suspension sheets; not shown here.
